cases.expect: A source-ranked conclusion with traceable precedence.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: no material evidence or authority conflict exists
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Host/system safety and organization policy remain above repository-level truth ordering.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: If a material conflict has no defensible domain/authority ordering, the resolver must not select a winner.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: evidence and authority, not fluency or optimization, determine conflict resolution

cases.given: A fluent secondary summary conflicts with a controlling direct source.
cases.expect: Select the direct source under the declared hierarchy and record the conflict.
cases.reject: Average the claims or prefer the clearer prose.
